programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: From marital spats to parenting disagreements, learn the biggest mistakes you're making.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Backstabbing takes many forms - lying, spreading gossip and fueling nasty rumors. Dr. Phil's guests say the ultimate betrayal didn't come from a stranger, but from their own sister!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: On the Outs With the In-Laws
programme.desc: Manipulative, violent, controlling, downright diabolical. These are some of the words Anna-Laura uses to describe her mother-in-law, Janice. Anna-Laura says her mother-in-law has threatened to take her children away, calls 12-15 times per day, peeks in their windows, goes through their trash, drives to Anna-Laura’s house and points her finger – from her car- as if she is pulling the trigger of a gun. Morgan says his mother also opens the front door and walks into their home unannounced. Anna-Laura says she got a restraining order against her mother-in-law after Janice hit her, which Janice denies. She says Janice is forcing her husband, Morgan, to choose between his mother and his wife. What can this family do to get along with one another?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Parents are concerned about the extreme measures their daughters take to get and keep a boyfriend.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: From spending $600,000 on 3-year-old beauty queens, to pushy stage sisters and an ambitious boxing coach — today's guests say they go to the extremes to help the youngest members of their family excel. Meet two fathers, one whose full-time job is managing his tiny stars' careers, and the other who hand makes each and every one of his 4-year-old daughter's costumes. Are these dads bonding with their daughters or simply pushing too hard? Plus, meet several women who defiantly criticize child beauty pageants. And, hear from one overzealous sister and the father of a boxing champion once ranked first in the world. Can Dr. Phil convince these guests to step aside and strive for balance in their children's lives?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Natalie says her husband, Brian, was in a tragic work accident in 2015 when he fell from a 68-foot crane. She says he was paralyzed from the knees down and claims he has stopped trying to live life. Natalie claims that since the accident, Brian has treated her and their 13-year old son, Jacob, like his slaves instead of his family. Natalie says her marriage with Brian has changed, and they don’t know how to communicate with one another. Brian says his family doesn’t understand what he is going through and that he is in too much pain to move. Brian also says Natalie’s parents, Sharyn and Dave, are too involved in his family’s lives, which is causing tension. Sharyn and Dave say they were trying to help their daughter since Natalie took on all of the responsibilities in her household.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The intense behavior of mothers who constantly monitor their children is examined and put to the test.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: How much should looking good factor into your relationship? Today’s guests say appearance matters, and their mate is not up to their standards! Sandi says after six years of marriage, she misses her husband, Otto’s, six-pack. He says working -- not working out -- is a priority for him, and nothing will satisfy his wife, who rates herself a 20 out of 10. But the couple does agree on one thing: whatever Sandi wants, Sandi gets. Will Otto agree to hit the gym? Then, Dawn worked hard to shed 150 pounds, and when the new svelte Dawn met Paul, sparks flew! He thought she was hot -- until she undressed. What is she hiding? Plus, discover why Dr. Phil wrestles with his decision to help Dawn and Paul. And, Cynthia says she’s embarrassed by her boyfriend’s outdated wardrobe, and refuses to be seen with him in public! Can a professional makeover change her opinion?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dan and Teresa say their 16-year-old identical twins, Dallas and Drew are violent, destructive and dangerous, and they fear someone will end up seriously hurt, or even dead. What’s at the root of the teens’ anger and extreme jealousy that’s driving them apart? Could the parents be contributing to the explosive situation? Broken bones, violent fights, destruction of property -- today’s guests aren’t enemies; they are 16-year-old identical twin brothers. Dr. Phil examines the jealousy and torment that's driving these siblings apart and throwing their home into chaos.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Amie says she has no idea how to control her 7-year-old son, Jayden, and even began posting videos of his outbursts online seeking help. But Jayden’s father, Chad, says Amie is just out for attention and blames her for their son’s problems. Can these exes learn to co-parent peacefully?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil’s guests say they are overworked and overwhelmed moms who are at their breaking points. First, Miranda, 21, is a mother of two and says that she’s responsible for all of the household chores while her husband, Dakota, 23, plays golf, gambles and hangs out with his friends. Miranda says she cries almost every day and feels resentful toward her husband. Dakota admits he likes to have a good time but says that he works hard to support his family and feels that Miranda should be responsible for all of the housework. He says that his young wife gets easily overstressed and that she is the problem. Can Dr. Phil help these two negotiate a plan that works for both of them? Then, Jessa has 10 kids, including 1-year-old triplets, and admits she’s overwhelmed but says her controlling nature makes it hard to delegate household tasks. Her husband, Jeremy, says Jessa takes care of everyone -- except herself. Professional organizer, Julie Morgenstern, takes a trip to Jessa’s home. Can she help Jessa streamline her daily tasks and put herself first?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil gives family freeloaders a wake-up call.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When Pierre, his wife, Amanda, and his mother, Yolande, came to see Dr. Phil, the couple complained his mom was a meddling-mother-in-law. Amanda said Yolande never approved of her, and Yolande admitted she wanted her son to be with a more educated woman. Is this family still at odds?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The honeymoon is over! Dr. Phil talks with newlyweds about their troubles, and he and Robin share some stories of how they make their marriage work.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tiffany says her relationship with her son’s father, Erik, was destroyed by his constant lying and empty promises, to the point where she completely cut him off and has not seen him in over three years. Erik admits he has lied to his ex-girlfriends. Then, just this past year, Erik dated Sheka who says after doing research midway through their relationship, she uncovered his lies and put a stop to their wedding plans. So, when did Erik begin to con and deceive people? As Erik is accused of one lie more shocking than the next, his mom, Jody, says her son has been lying since he was a child. And, don't miss part 2, when more women come forward from Erik’s past.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Brandon is a drug addict in recovery who credits Dr. Phil’s intervention with saving his life. Now, he and his mother, Debbie, pay it forward by staging interventions for families and their drug addicted loved ones. Dee saw an episode with Brandon and wrote to Dr. Phil for help with her 23-year-old twin daughters, Brooke and Tiffany, who are addicted to heroin and other prescription drugs. Both women have young children, who are often left to parent each other, as well as take care of their sick mothers. Dee and her husband, Danny, and their two other children, Ashley and Derrick, are united in the goal to save the girls’ lives, but will they be prepared when Dr. Phil makes them all take a hard look at themselves? Find out why Dr. Phil says the whole family is sick. Will the twins agree to treatment? And what will happen to their children? Don’t miss this shocking story!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A headline making story of a husband’s affair with a co-worker that led to murder. Now the wife and the mistress come face to face for the first time.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his conversation with Christina, who emailed him desperate for help for her daughter, Tara, who she says can be an angry monster. Christina left the home when Tara was 13 years old, but now, she says she's worried that her daughter is in a toxic situation with the ex-husband she calls narcissistic and his 22-year-old new wife who is 20 weeks pregnant. Today, meet the new wife and find out if Dr. Phil can help this chaotic triangle.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: One man says he caught his wife cheating – on audiotape – but she denies the accusations. Who’s really telling the truth? Dr. Phil gets to the bottom of the alleged affair on tape. Can this relationship survive without trust?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Bridget says she’s not sure what to believe about the relationship between her 38-year-old brother-in-law, Kevin, and 16-year-old daughter, Grace.Dr. Phil says Bridget is a parent in denial and in need of a wake-up call. He sits down one-on-one with Kevin. How does Kevin explain his actions?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Renee and Lee insist their 6-year-old granddaughter is not safe in the care of her parents, Chris and Jessica, because they are severe alcoholics. Despite admitting their alcoholism, Chris and Jessica insist they are great parents, and claim Chris’ parents stole their daughter from them when they demanded Chris and Jessica sign over temporary guardianship of their little girl. Dr. Phil shows Renee and Lee shocking footage of what his cameras captured during Chris and Jessica’s home interviews. After seeing the footage, will Chris and Jessica still stand by their position that their drinking does not place their daughter in danger?

programme.sub-title: Is There a Predator in the House?
programme.desc: As a parent, you're likely to be concerned about sexual predators who could potentially gain access to your child. But what if you suspected a child molester were living under the same roof as your child or grandchild? Dr. Phil tackles the stories of two concerned moms.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Em says her husband, Shawn, has cheated on her with at least 78 women -- so why does she keep taking him back? Shawn admits to at least 20 affairs but says it’s his wife’s fault that he strays.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: George and Cindy Anthony speak out for the first time about their daughter, Casey's trial.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Two sisters struggles to detox and remain clean from drugs. Dr. Phil shows them a scary glimpse of their future.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: How to Get to I Do
programme.desc: For many girls, a fairytale wedding day is a sweet fantasy -- but getting the proposal can be a real nightmare! Amber and Rich are struggling through commitment issues. They live, work and have children together, and say they're happy but can't seem to take the next step. Rich sold Amber on his plan to marry her after five years, so why hasn't he proposed after nearly seven? Does he have valid reasons for resisting marriage? After Dr. Phil challenges him, will Rich decide to walk down the aisle ... on Dr. Phil's stage? Next, Jill has taken the leap and been divorced seven times. Why does she pick the wrong men, and what can she do to make her next union last? Then, Candy describes her first marriage as lasting 18 miserable years, and she regrets how she poisoned her daughters against men during that time. What will it take to change her daughter, who calls herself the Runaway Bride? Plus, a don't-miss moment happens in Dr. Phil's audience!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: An engagement symbolizes a commitment you make to one special person. But Dr. Phil's guests are accused of the ultimate betrayal: cheating on their spouse-to-be right before walking down the aisle.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: He’s a tough-guy afraid of loosing his freedom. She’s been through two ugly divorces. So when the “M” word comes up, they head for the hills. Join these commitment-challenged singles as Dr. Phil uncovers the reasons why they won’t take the plunge. You’ll also meet a man who, after a four years in a loving relationship, doesn’t see the need to get married. To him it’s just a piece of paper. To her it’s a lot more. Find out if it’s really a “deal breaker.”

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Many women are itching to run to the altar, but Dr. Phil’s guests say they’re ready to run for the hills! Kelly is a self-proclaimed runaway bride. She’s been engaged four times but says she gets cold feet before she makes it down the aisle. Rick, her current fiancé, proposed four years ago and is still waiting for her to set a wedding date. Kelly believes that most marriages end in divorce, and she doesn’t want to become another statistic. Should Rick wait for her to make up her mind, or should he cut his losses and move on? Then, Chad and Candi have been engaged for over five years and have two daughters, but Chad says he’s not ready to tie the knot. He says weddings are too expensive, but Candi says he racked up $49,000 in loans for a car, a camper and a new deck for the house. Will Chad break down and give his fiancée the wedding of her dreams? Plus, Dr. Phil talks to a woman who says her fiancé left her six days before the wedding and stuck her with a $150,000 bill -- an allegation he totally denies.

She says her husband, John, lied about how many times he’d been married, but the biggest tale of all is that he’s still married to another woman! John admits that he lied about being divorced, but says Melissa wouldn’t have stayed with him if he told her the truth. Will Melissa ever be able to trust him again ... and should she? programme.sub-title: Skinwalker Ranch AAWSAP, Dinobeaver, Hitchhiker Ghosts, Pentagon, UFOs
programme.desc: The people running the Pentagon's Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Application Program (AAWSAP) claim they encountered UFOs, demons, werewolves and "dinobeaver" monsters at "Skinwalker Ranch" in Utah. But, their most jaw-dropping claim is that a paranormal "infectious disease" is being spread across the United States.

programme.title: I Witness Roswell Alien Legacy
programme.desc: When the U.S. Army base in Roswell, NM closed in 1967 it looked like this little town might dry up and blow away. The town was slowly rebuilding its economy when it stumbled on an unexpected boon. Roswell found the Alien. A little known local legend had kicked around for years. It said that, in 1947. something crashed in the desert just north of town and the military covered up the incident. Now, thanks to the legend, Roswell is on the cover of Time Magazine and the pheonix-like rise from the ashes is complete. As tens of thousands of tourists and their fat wallets land in Roswell, we join the search for the truth.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Jeff Gustafson
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance at the 2023 Bassmaster Classic, watch Jeff Gustafson's dominant performance as he wins for the second time on Fort Loudoun and Tellico. Gussy started strong with 18-8 and 17-3 over Day 1 and 2, but on the final day he needed every bit of his lead to hold off the hard-charging field of anglers looking to make up weight and try to win the Bassmaster Classic

programme.title: Peak Performance - Drew Benton
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance at the 2023 Lake Murray Bassmaster Elite Series, watch Drew Benton's tournament as he notched his 2nd Bassmaster victory. Benton started the week in 2nd place, jumped into the lead, fell to 10th and then completed a comeback of over 5 pounds on the Final Day to win.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Brock Mosley
programme.desc: In his 8-year Bassmaster Elite Series career, Brock Mosley has been so close to major titles but fallen just short with 5 2nd place finishes and even more Top 10’s. Watch Mosley put four great days together on his way to his first Elite Series title at the 2023 Folds of Honor Bassmaster Elite at the Sabine River and take home the Marathon Peak Performance!

programme.title: Peak Performance - Tyler Rivet
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance from Lake Okeechobee, follow Tyler Rivet as he closes in on his first Bassmaster Elite Series title. Rivet is a 5th year Elite Series pro who started his career in college at Nicholls State where he formed a Bass Team and fished in every Bassmaster National Championship during his five years in school.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Takumi Ito
programme.desc: Taku Ito got another blue trophy on the Bassmaster Elite Series with his big win at Smith Lake. Relive his week in Alabama where he conquered spotted bass en route to his second Elite Series win since joining the top ranks in 2020.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Jay Przekurat
programme.desc: As a 23-year old rookie on the Bassmaster Elite Series, Jay Przekurat made history. In the Marathon Peak Performance at the St. Lawrence River, Przekurat becomes the youngest Elite Series champion and also breaks 100 pounds for the first time in history for a smallmouth bass event. Watch his week unfold in Clayton, NY.

programme.title: Black Tigress
programme.desc: Lola, a saloon dancer, arrives in Sant'Anna, a town terrorized by outlaw El Diablo, who aims to sell the land to a railroad. With the help of Rod, a young admirer, Lola inspires the townspeople to rise up and fight for their land.

programme.title: Dig Your Grave Friend... Sabata's Coming
programme.desc: Steve McGowan returns from war to avenge his father’s murder by a ruthless landowner. Imprisoned, he escapes with a bandit and steals a stagecoach—only to find the villain’s fiancée inside. As hired guns close in, alliances shift, and the fight for justice takes an unexpected turn.

programme.title: The Executioner of God
programme.desc: A former gunman turned priest seeks vengeance on three bandits who are masquerading as law-abiding citizens.

programme.title: Two Faces of the Dollar
programme.desc: A teacher, a hero, an ex-colonel, and a beautiful woman plan to rob Fort Henderson. Though the heist succeeds, their troubles have only just begun, as greed, betrayal, and danger threaten to unravel their carefully laid plan.

programme.title: I Am Sartana, Your Angel of Death
programme.desc: A bank that was thought to be impenetrable is robbed by a man wearing the trademark Sartana cloak. Our black-clad hero soon has a price on his head and must try to proof his innocence with the help of his shabby friend Buddy Ben.

programme.title: The Counterfeit Kid
programme.desc: Jack, a farmhand, accidentally impersonates the notorious outlaw "Bloody" Ben Harris. Now, on a treasure hunt, he must rely on a group of wild misfits to outsmart the outlaw he's pretending to be. With Harris hot on his trail, Jack must find the treasure and return to his true love, Olivia, before it’s too late.

programme.title: Cjamango
programme.desc: Just when Cjamango has won a bag of gold in a poker game, he is attacked by the gangs of El Tigre and Don Pablo.

programme.title: And God Said to Cain
programme.desc: After ten years in prison for a crime he didn’t commit, ex-Confederate officer Gary Hamilton returns to seek revenge on Acombar, the man who framed him and stole both his gold and his lover. Surrounded by enemies, Hamilton uses the town’s secret tunnels to strike back in a stormy, haunting showdown.

programme.title: California
programme.desc: After the Civil War, Michael "California" Random, is released from prison and goes to Missouri with his partner William.

programme.title: Savage Pampas
programme.desc: In the late 1800's, an army captain tries to tame the open plains of Argentina which are dominated by Indians and bandits. To help do this, the captain brings in a party of women to keep his soldiers happy.

programme.title: Quinto: Fighting Proud
programme.desc: After a bank heist, a gang of outlaws convenes at a desert saloon, only to find the loot missing. Suspicion and paranoia spiral out of control, leading them to turn on each other in a deadly struggle for survival.

programme.title: $100,000 for Ringo
programme.desc: Stranger Lee Barton rides into Rainbow Valley, mistaken for a man thought dead. As tensions rise with ruthless town boss Tom Cherry—who's after hidden gold and the affections of a local woman—Barton is drawn into violence and revenge. With a sheriff's help, he seeks justice and a new start with a boy who believes he's his father.

programme.title: A Coffin for the Sheriff
programme.desc: Spaghetti Western icon Anthony Steffen stars as Shenandoah, a mysterious man who joins a ruthless band of highwaymen after overcoming an almost impossible and death-defying initiation.

programme.title: The Restless Breed
programme.desc: After Mitch Baker’s father is killed by gun-runners, he follows them to Mexico for revenge. In the border town of Mission, Texas, Mitch faces off with gang leader Jim Simmons, determined to take justice into his own hands, despite warnings from the sheriff.

programme.title: Murieta!
programme.desc: The story of Joaquin Murrieta, a real life Mexican bandit who terrorized California with his gang of raiders and cutthroats during the first half of the 19th century. Some saw him as a murderous outlaw, others as the Mexican Robin Hood.

programme.title: Dorian Gray
programme.desc: Dorian, a young man of rare beauty, is shocked by a painter's stunning portrait of him. Knowing that sooner or later the harmony of his features will be faded by time, while the portrait will always remain the same, Dorian makes a wish: that only the portrait will grow old!

programme.title: My Name Is Rocco Papaleo
programme.desc: Rocco Papaleo, an optimistic and kind man from a mining town in Alaska, gets away from his company during a trip to Chicago and is increasingly disillusioned in the face of the city's hostility.

programme.title: Hen Party
programme.desc: Five women meet to celebrate the hen night of one of them. It is the bride who has organised everything, but she is not there and leaves clues that lead the four bridesmaids across the eternal city to their old high school. In the meantime, the friends have talked, discussed, argued, tackled the most diverse topics. Until the final big surprise.

programme.title: The Cheerleaders
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. Three lovely ladies form a group with one desire; stay away from love and use men only for their own selfish desires. However, two of them fall in love and create a crack in the group. The remaining one stays true to the creed of The Cheerleaders and stays off love and men. But love would eventually puncture through the tough wall she had built against it and she would come to find out one thing in the end; everybody can find true love.

programme.title: Besotted
programme.desc: Besotted revolves around Rita who seems to be fooled by what she thought was love for her boyfriend Michael, only for her to find out that he squandered her money on illegal activities. This leaves Rita devastated, she tries to turn him over to the police but the unexpected happens.

programme.title: Golmaal Returns
programme.desc: Gopal’s life hits choppy waters when he gets stuck on a yacht for a night upon rescuing an attractive young woman by fighting off some goons. Now, he has his wife suspecting him of having an affair and a police officer on his tail.

programme.title: Charanon Ki Saugandh
programme.desc: Ravi (Mithun Chakraborty) is the son of a poor farmer forced to work as a servant for a powerful local landowner (Prem Chopra). During the village elections, Ravi decides to take a stand by running against the wealthy tyrant, thus inviting the landowner's wrath in the process.

programme.title: Dance Dance
programme.desc: Two siblings Radha (Smita Patil) and Ramu (Mithun Chakraborty) emerge from poverty and become popular performers, that is, until tragedy strikes them. 'Dance Dance' is the journey of Ramu who vows to take revenge against the man who exploited his mother, murdered his father and tortured his sister.

programme.title: Fiffty Fiffty
programme.desc: Bihari's (Om Shivpuri) father loses his ancestral estate to Virendra Singh's (Ranjeet) family, who now live on the land in a palatial house. Singh has a son named Kishan (Rajesh Khanna). Bihari feels that they do not deserve the riches and sets out to swap his own infant son with Kishan. An attempt to stop him is made by Virendra, who gets killed. Bihari's wife tries to stop her husband but is unable to do so. Bihari thus manages to hide the truth from everyone. He hands over Kishan to his brother in Mumbai and introduces him to the life of crime, then watches as his own son grows up surrounded by riches. Will they ever find the truth about their lineage?

programme.title: Best of Morning Footy
programme.desc: CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK is a first-of-its-kind free, 24-hour channel in the U.S.dedicated exclusively to global soccer coverage. CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK, with its unparalleled coverage of all the top domestic and international soccer competitions across the globe, is the ultimate year-round streaming destination for soccer fans. CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK is anchored weekdays from 7:00-9:00 AM, ET, by - MORNING FOOTY, the Network’s flagship morning show. Every weekday, MORNING FOOTY host Susannah Collins along with former U.S. Men’s National Team player Charlie Davies, analyst Nico Cantor and comedian Alexis Guerreros bring their unique voices and fresh perspectives to the latest news and storylines impacting soccer worldwide. As soccer’s new staple show for fans everywhere, MORNING FOOTY delivers a daily dose of razor-sharp insights and laughs with match highlights, compelling analysis, entertaining interviews, updates - from reporter Jenny Chiu and more that is sure to help kick off your day. In addition, the Network will feature live matches, pre- and post-match breakdowns, magazine shows, films from Paramount+’s STORIES FROM THE BEAUTIFUL GAME soccer documentary collection and original programming. The Network’s live matches and re-airs utilize CBS Sports’ collection of top-tier soccer properties, including UEFA club competitions, Serie A, NWSL, Concacaf national team competitions, Barclays Women’s Super League, Campeonato Brasileirão Série A, Scottish Professional Football League, Argentina Liga Profesional de Fútbol and the AFC Champions League, among others. Watch CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK 24 hours a day, 7 days a week and all 365 days a year.

programme.desc: It's very big and mostly comes in orange: the KTM 990 Adventure. Over rough terrain it's often driven standing up. Today, the 990 is considered the off-road specialist among travel Enduros.

programme.desc: In the late 1950s, the Facel Vega Facellia was designed to compete with Porsche and Alfa Romeo and open a new market segment for the fledgling French luxury car company.

programme.title: Put your car on TV
programme.sub-title: Chevy Camaro vs Mercedes SLS AMG
programme.desc: Hosts Mylene Gomera and Saif Hattawi invite petrol heads from the Middle East to bring their tuned cars to the 'The Walk' at Jumeirah Beach and have it rated in the categories speed, style and sound. Whoever receives the most points, wins a one night stay for two people at this glamorous Sofitel Dubai Jumeirah Beach. On this episode, a Chevrolet Camaro and Mercedes SLS AMG try to impress.

programme.title: Put your car on TV
programme.desc: If you want to see out-of-this-world, customized or tuned luxury vehicles or posh cars you need to go to 'The Walk', the glamorous boulevard of Jumeirah Beach. Put Your Car on TV invites car owners to have their vehicles judged by Saif Hattawi. The person with the most points wins a special treat from the Sofitel Dubai Jumeirah Beach. Among the presented cars are a BMW X5 and a Mercedes SLK 230.

programme.title: Put your car on TV
programme.desc: People from the Middle East are crazy about their cars. On Put Your Car on TV they have the chance to present their tuned vehicles and judged. They are awarded points based on speed, style and sound and the car owner with the most points, wins a special treat for two from the Sofitel Dubai Jumeirah Beach. Among the competitors are a Nova SS, a special Honda Acord and a car full of crystals.

programme.title: Bentley Bentayga
programme.desc: With the Bentley Bentayga, the traditional British brand is entering the fastest growing market segment. This world's first luxury SUV is a conglomerate of superlatives on wheels.

programme.title: Mercedes Sprinter, 2018
programme.desc: The Mercedes Sprinter belongs to the class of commercial vehicles. The light transporter is the dream for every tradesman. The third generation Sprinter is sleeker, more modern and more variable than ever.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: Frank Slopianka is a racing junkie and constantly takes part in such events. US car fans Kati and Patrick join him for the Race 61, a rock and race festival in Finowfurt near Berlin. There Frank and and his Dragster Camaro take part in the 1/8 mile race.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.sub-title: Mercedes 280 SE goes America - French Riviera
programme.desc: German entrepeneur Tillmann Miritz loves vintage cars and has a dream: driving through the USA in his Mercedes Cabriolet 280 SE 3.5. He drives along the picturesque French Riviera and visits a classic car collector before his 280 gets shipped.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.sub-title: Mercedes 280 SE goes America - New York
programme.desc: Tillmann starts his dream journey in New York, the city that never sleeps. With his Mercedes 280 SE convertible he visits the legendary classic car dealer Eliot Cuker who made his fortune with his passion for old cars.

programme.title: Arden AJ23
programme.desc: A Jaguar that is able to terrify the world alone with its roar. This Jaguar F-Type R tuned by Arden is a real bad boy. Already in the series production configuration, the F-Type R Coupe is a dream car that can really bite but this Jaguar which has been upgraded from Arden, now calls itself "AJ23“ and is more powerful, louder and more aggressive than any of his brothers.

programme.title: Jaguar XJR
programme.desc: The highlight of the XJR lies beneath the hood: all of Jaguar's top models are equipped with the 5-liter V8 compressor engine that delivers 550 HP in this sports sedan.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: The Nürburgring is the place where you can really let your hair down on a spectacular and difficult race track and learn how to get fit for motor sports. This is the reason why motoring enthusiasts go there throughout the year.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: We prepared some very entertaining clips from the Nürburgring for you. Expect to see the pedal on the metal and rubber burning.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: When the weather cleared up a bit at the Nürburgring, we were finally back at the track. As soon as the snow and ice were gone the horsepower junkies returned to the ring to once again let their engines roar.

programme.title: Artega GT
programme.desc: From 2006 to 2012 the German company Artega produced their GT sports car model. Thanks to the know-how of a former Porsche and BMW manager the Artega GT was able to be manufactured in a small series.

programme.title: Ferrari California T
programme.desc: The Ferrari California T has a lot of Italian passion and elegant lines to offer. Super sports car cabriolets are popular all over the world. It is no wonder that more and more manufacturers are 'opening up'.

programme.title: Chevrolet Caprice 9C1 police car
programme.desc: This 1994 Chevrolet Caprice 9C1 is a former police car from the Los Angeles Police Department. Its curvaceous body was often mocked as looking like a whale, but this Chevy Caprice possesses the qualities of a shark.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Smart offers its iconic city car with a convertible option. The Mini cabriolet is bigger and provides room for four people. When it comes to roadster feeling, the Mazda MX-5 is on top of the list. We took a closer look at these three open-top contenders.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: The Paris Motor Show features the automotive world of tomorrow. In 2016 Mercedes-Benz introduced their “Generation EQ” and Volkswagen announced to build 20 new electrified models by 2020, possibly in order to distract from the emission scandal.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: What would make coupe fans opt for a more traditional two-door model like the Mercedes-Benz E400 instead of its bigger brother, the CLS with four doors? Also: does the Volkswagen Arteon stand a chance against the Mercedes CLS?

programme.title: Arden AJ23
programme.desc: A Jaguar that is able to terrify the world alone with its roar. This Jaguar F-Type R tuned by Arden is a real bad boy. Already in the series production configuration, the F-Type R Coupe is a dream car that can really bite but this Jaguar which has been upgraded from Arden, now calls itself "AJ23“ and is more powerful, louder and more aggressive than any of his brothers.

programme.title: Volvo S90
programme.desc: It looks sportier than one might expect from the Swedes. The taillights frame the powerful looking rear. On the inside, the Volvo S90 impresses with the finest materials and soft nappa leather.

programme.title: Audi MTM S8 Talladega R
programme.desc: The Audi S8 Plus is by no means underpowered, but it is and remains faithful to this model series' understatement. Those who want more power can get a boost from MTM.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: With the GTR, Nissan tried to take on the established European sports car manufacturers. For less than half the price the GTR was a more affordable direct competitor to Porsche's 911 Turbo S or the Audi R8 GT. In addition: one of the ultimate super cars, the Techart 911 Turbo S with 620 hp. And: the Pagani Huayra, presented and driven by Formula 1 Pilot Adrian Sutil.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: It's not always a car's pure power that makes driving through curves exciting. The Subaru BRZ with its low boxer engine and its well-balanced handling gives his driver a very good feeling for the road. The BMW 235i RS has a great rear wheel performance and the Porsche Cayman GTS with its mid-engine puts a smile on your face as soon as you put your foot on the accelerator.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: With the creation of its i8, Munich-based car manufacturer BMW makes a big step towards the future. After all, the futuristic looking car is the first German sports car which utilizes hybrid technology. Supercars checks out the BMW i8 on the streets of Los Angeles. But BMW did not just work on the i8. They also present the new sports coupe 435i and the sporty SUV X550d M.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: If you have only sat in the back of a big limousine and if you don't know how much these kind of limousines are, you are probably part of the management. When it comes to driving experience and performance, it makes sense that the driver¿s seat is less attractive. But that's only the case for seasoned state cars anyways. The Audi RS and Mercedes S-Class might even make some chauffeurs unemployed.

programme.title: McLaren 570 GT
programme.desc: Onboard the McLaren 570 GT on the island of Tenerife

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: The Stunt Heroes from the German company Action Concept really let it rip. This time stuntman Paul slides through under an exploding vehicle. At the same time gangster bride Anna flies through the air.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: The Stunt Heroes face a new mission: performing a front-flip through the air with a stuntman behind the wheel of an estate wagon. Stuntmen Daniel and Lars display a brilliant fight choreography in some spectacular driving scenes.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: Stuntman Tobi operates an Artega GT at full speed via remote control. This is just a warm-up before the big stunt, in which he drives a car up a steep ramp at 68 mph. The question is: How high can remote-controlled cars fly?

programme.title: Bentley S2 Continental Flying Spur
programme.desc: Flowing lines and an elegance that is unmatched. The 1959 Bentley S2 Continental Flying Spur aims to build bridges in the company's model range. From the sporty origin of the brand to the luxury of its new owner, Rolls Royce.

programme.title: Beradino
programme.desc: A „bella macchina“, a beautiful car - but not designed by masters like Bertone or Pininfarina. Johannes Paulussen from Neuss in Germany built the Beradino by hand.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: British limousines are the embodiment of luxury, they are the automotive upper class. Built with the most exclusive materials, these limousines like the Rolls Royce Phantom, Bentley Mulsanne or Jaguar XJ combine luxury, comfort and power.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Whether it is the Mercedes S-Class, the BMW 7-series or the Audi A8, limousines "Made in Germany" are considered status symbols, setting standards when it comes to comfort, pioneering technologies and safety.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: International limousines by Rolls Royce, Bentley, Mercedes, BMW and Jaguar guarantee an exclusive appearance and stand for status, prestige and perfection. They are the benchmark when it comes to luxury and comfort.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Power limousines like the BMW M5, Mercedes-AMG E63, Audi RS6 and Mulsanne Speed offer a unique mix of style, performance and suitability for daily use. They combine the luxury of a limousine with the dynamics of a super sports car.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: They are masterpieces of automotive art, cars of breathtaking elegance, extraordinary performance, built for speeds beyond imagination: Bugatti Chiron, Lykan Hypersports, Pagani Huayra and Ferrari LaFerrari.

programme.title: BMW Kelleners Sport 640i Grand Coupe
programme.desc: The Kelleners Sport 640i is based on one of the most beautiful 4-door coupes. The tuning company of Ralf Kelleners, the son of a three-time European touring car champion, made a name for itself by specializing in remodeling BMWs.

programme.title: Volkswagen Touareg V6 TDI
programme.desc: Volkswagen subjected the Touareg to a radical makeover. After the end of the Phaeton, it's the new luxury top model from VW. Hopes are high: it has to sell big so that management can restore the peoples' confidence in the Volkswagen brand.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: A trend is on the rise: going on mountain cruises in a sports car. As super cars become more comfortable and suitable for travelling in spite of their ever-increasing performance, what would be the perfect sports car for taking on the Alps: the Lamborghini Aventador Miura Homage, the Ferrari 458 Speciale, the McLaren 570S or the Porsche 911 Turbo S?

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: To drive or be driven: That is the question for people who can afford such a choice. When it comes to the Bentley Mulsanne with its extended wheelbase, one could be more delighted to sit in the back of the car than in the front. But what is the situation when it comes to the sporty Maserati Quattroporte? Or the upgraded BMW 7 series by Alpina with the model name B7? Or the original, the BMW 750i?

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Would you prefer a turbocharged or rather a naturally aspirated engine? With the 7th generation Chevrolet Corvette, buyers were able to choose between either. What's the more convincing model variation, the Grand Sport or Z06? Also: the McLaren 720, with its 4-litre BiTurbo V8. And: taking part in the "Bavaria Sportwagen Tour" with an AMG GTR.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: If you had the choice to select three cars for every occasion, which models would receive a spot in your garage? We took a look at the Rolls Royce Phantom, the Aston Martin DBS Superleggera and the Audi RS4 for this little mindgame.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: In 2018, the Audi R8 Quattro Performance received an upgrade. The new version shared some of its aerodynamic features with the Lamborghini Huracan. Also: the Porsche Macan S got a more powerful engine.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The rebirth of French chic: the elegant DS 9 from Citroen's luxury brand. Plus: the Genesis GV80 offers luxury at a low price. And: a test drive in the exorbitantly expensive Mercedes-Benz 300 SL.

programme.title: Saab 93 and Saab 99 Turbo
programme.desc: In 1937 an airplane manufacturing company was founded in Sweden that later became the famous car manufacturer Saab. We present two of their iconic car models, the Saab 93 and 99 Turbo.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: What's the perfect winter car for ultimate fun in the snow? The BMW X6 M and the Lada Niva have to prove themselves in the Ulten Valley in South Tyrol in Italy. Plus: High speed, adrenaline and pure action at the Snow Mobile show in Austria.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: The search for the perfect winter car is still on. Patrick Simons puts the Subaru WRX STI and Audi RS6 Clubsport from MTM through their paces. Plus: With the MP4-12C, McLaren brings a successor to their famous F1 model to the streets.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: The Volkswagen Jetta is a big seller in the United States. With the sixth generation, Volkswagen wants the model to be successful with European car buyers, too. Plus: we take a look at the new Ford Focus and the BMX X3.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: Patrick Simon reviews the Porsche Cayenne S Hybrid. Below its hood is a 333 HP V6 engine and a 47 horsepower electrical motor. Plus: Upcoming racing driver Chris Bauer at the FIA GT1 championship at the Nürburgring.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: Test driver Patrick Simon wants to take part in the 24 Hours of Le Mans and reviews his LMPC car. Plus: we compare the Volkswagen Tiguan 2.0 TDI to the Kia Sportage 2.0 CRDI.

programme.title: 2017 Quiksilver Pro Gold Coast Finals Day | REPLAY
programme.desc: It was an emotional day full of twists and turns, not the least of which was Matt Wilkinson's return to the Final at Snapper for the second straight year. Fanning, Smith and Andino will need to do better at the Margaret River event if they hope to stay in touch with the early leaders. The Title chase is officially on, and there are heaps of great stories and moments to look forward to as the Tour moves to West Oz.

programme.title: WSL Inside Pro Surfing
programme.sub-title: Inside Pro Surfing: Surf Abu Dhabi Pro 2025
programme.desc: The WSL Championship Tour makes its groundbreaking debut in the Middle East at the 2025 Surf Abu Dhabi Pro. The second stop on the CT marks professional surfing's continued global expansion and also establishes Abu Dhabi as an official surf destination. Engineered for excellence, this high-performance wave will provide a canvas for the world's best surfers set against a stunning backdrop of the Arabian Gulf. The event will showcase not only the remarkable evolution of professional surfing beyond its traditional roots, but also the infinite possibility for progression from athletes like rookie Erin Brooks, former World Champion Italo Ferreira, and reigning World Champ Caity Simmers.

programme.title: WSL Replay
programme.sub-title: REPLAY | All the Action from the Surf City El Salvador Pro 2025
programme.desc: Where the Pacific's perfect right-hand point break meets an unparalleled competition venue, the Surf City El Salvador Pro delivers an opportunity for CT athletes to earn critical points in the rankings ahead of the Mid-season Cut. Long, powerful walls offer endless opportunity for progressive maneuvers while the hollow sections demand split-second decision-making that can test even the most seasoned CT competitor. Replay all the action of Final's Day at Punta Roca.

programme.title: All In: Life on the WSL Championship Tour

programme.desc: As the surfers make final preparations to travel to their next WSL World Championship Tour events in France for the Quiksilver & Roxy Pro, they reflect on their 2018 season so far. For Julian Wilson and Lakey Peterson, a World Title is within reach. And while Carissa Moore and Jordy Smith are out of the title hunt this year, they still want to prove they are the two best surfers in the world. programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Matt is out for revenge. Last year Dale beat him badly at the Annual Vintage bike race in Barber, Alabama. But this year there is a whole new tale to tell. With just days until the race - Dale is secretly struggling to get the bike he beat Matt with last year up and working. Matt struggles just to locate a 100-year old bike. Matt's prayers are answered thanks to an old Catholic Priest he located who has possession of a bike. The priest might let Matt have the bike to race - but there are conditions. The toughest one: Don't tell Dale you have it. Can Matt afford to buy the bike and get it running in time for the race without Dale seeing it? Will Dale even get his broken bike started? And if they ever get to race, will Matt exact his revenge?

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Built in the mid-60’s by eccentric engineer “Wild Bill” Gelbke, the Road Dog was, and still is, the largest motorcycle ever built. It utilized aircraft tubing, Corvette disc brakes, and a Chevy truck differential to keep it stable. The one-off creation disappeared when Gelbke did in 1978. Outflanked once when the bike was spotted and sold to a private collector in 1995, Dale has vowed to locate the machine and make Wheels Through Time its final resting place.

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress E01 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. - - The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. - - Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. - - Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. - - The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. - - The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. - - Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. - - Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. - - The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: Around the ACL
programme.desc: ATA 203: Mid-Season Stock Report, Fan Takes, and If the Season Ended Today This week on Around the ACL, Meesh, Jake, and Anthony take a mid-season pulse check on the 2026 ACL season. We kick things off with a Mid-Season Stock Report, discussing whose stock is rising fastest, which players are feeling the most pressure, the doubles teams to watch, and the biggest surprises and disappointments so far. Then we turn it over to the community in Fans Weigh In, reacting to listener takes and perspectives from across the cornhole world. From there, we ask the big hypothetical: If the season ended today, who’s your MVP, Rookie of the Year, Doubles Team of the Year, most clutch player, and who owns the best mental game? We wrap up with a round of Over/Under, breaking down expectations for top players and teams, before closing with bold predictions and rapid-fire takes in Hole-y Hot Take. Mid-season storylines are forming — and this episode dives right into them.

programme.title: Going Beyond
programme.desc: Going Beyond is wanderlust-filled hitchhiker Mariia Khandus’s new travel project. She’s journeyed around the world. Everybody knows that Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia are great places to relax with wonderful beaches and delicious fruits! But what do you know about the local people? The expats? About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!

programme.title: National Treasures
programme.desc: In this programme, he visits Plas Newydd on the island of Anglesey in north west Wales, which the Trust acquired in the 1970s. Once it was the family home of the Marquis of Anglesey, and now property manager Nerys Jones has to think of new ways to attract visitors to this remote location.

programme.title: The World Is Yours
programme.desc: We'll tour the exotic city of Istanbul in Turkey, formerly known as Constantinople. It is the most populated city in Turkey and occasionally confused as its capital as it is Turkey's historical, economic and cultural center of the country. We'll sail through the Bosphorus, the river that separates its European part from its Asian part. Our journey through Istanbul continues through the Blue Mosque, built between 1609 and 1616. A unique experience is to visit the Grand with more than 50 streets where thousands of tourists look for the best prices every day. Then, we will visit Dubai, a real and exciting treasure that awaits us on the coast of the Persian Gulf. Located in the Arabian desert, its culture reflects a clear Islamic influence that can be seen in its clothing, social traditions, art and literature. Being its luxurious architecture what causes greater contrast, Maybe thats why Dubai is the city with the most avant-garde architecture in the world and it has already become the third city with the highest number of skyscrapers.Finally, we will travel to Las Vegas, surrounded by large mountains and in the middle of the Mojave Desert, in Nevada. Today you will discover that Las Vegas is much more than luck, lights and imitators of Elvis Presley. There are a number of different experiences and equally huge ... as is usually the case in Las Vegas.

programme.title: Follow Alana Australia
programme.desc: Discovering wetlands and pristine beaches, Alana gets up close with the wildest of Aussie flora and fauna, learning about the natural beauty in Australia - and most importantly, how to take care of it.

programme.title: Lost And Found
programme.desc: We venture back out onto Root Glacier to complete our goal of doing a polar plunge. Then we start the long journey towards the US and Canadian Border and stop to explore a road that wanders along side a glacier to find a camp spot for the night.

programme.title: Hidden Italy
programme.desc: Situated between the Alps in France and the duchy of Savoy, and influenced by both regions, the Marquisate was still able to maintain its core identity, and gave birth to a rich local culture. This spirit exists in the Rocca of Castellar; in the Castello of Manta, with the fresco cycle of the Nine Worthies in the Baronial Hall or the painting of the Madonna del Latte in the church of Santa Maria.

programme.desc: Phillip is welcomed to another celebrity chef outlet, Daniel Boulud’s DB Bistro where the classic Parisian bistro is reinterpreted under Executive Chef, American Jonathan Kinsella’s watchful eye.

programme.sub-title: Episodio 90: Sospechas, Celos y Secretos Revelados
programme.desc: La Nena esta nerviosa y furiosa a la vez, pues no quiere que Aristigueta se entere que ella tiene pareja y menos de la clase de Doroteo, o sea un limpio, el trata por todos los medios de quedarse un rato mas y ella no haya que mas hacer para que se vaya, le dice que quiere hablar con su hija, despu s le pide el ba o prestado, ella le dice que no sirve, le dice que entonces le preste el de su cuarto, le dice que no sirve tampoco, luego hace una llamada y es justo al celular de Theo, cuando suena el tel fono Aristigueta ya no le cabe la menor duda y en efecto lo que el sospecha es cierto, ella esta empatada con la Nena, Theo responde la llamada y conversa de los mas amigable con su doctor, sin sospechar nada, luego Aristigueta complacido pues una vez mas se salio con la suya se retira, dejando a la Nena mas confundida que antes, por que ese hombre se le viene a aparecer en su vida ahora despu s de tantos a os, Theo se da cuenta que llora y le pregunta que le pasa ella le inventa un cuento. Otra que no le cabe la frustraci n y la rabia es a Gladis que al ver llegar a Remedios se le caen todas las esperanzas de tener algo con su Gabito, a el le pasa exactamente lo mismo, trata de arreglar la cosa, le dice a Gladis que se llevar a Remedios pero que el regresa para seguir con lo que estaban hablando, pero que va ya Gladis esta muy molesta y decide irse a dormir, a lo que Gabito lo toma cono un rechazo, ahora tendr que ver que se inventa para que a Gladis se le pase la rabia, Aureliano bromea con la llega de su mam , a Dileidi por supuesto que le molesta pues siempre le esta echando broma a su mam , cuando llega al cuarto encuentra a Gladis llorando y quej ndose de su mala suerte, ella trata de reanimarla, le dice que gracias a ella y a sus rega os descubri que le gusta realmente la ingenier a y que no solamente se va a graduar como ingeniero para complacerla a ella sino que lo har por doble raz n pues quiere ser una de las mejores, ya que le gusta lo que esta estudiando, tambi n suben al cuarto Gerson y Aleisi, quienes saben que su mam esta triste y le dicen que ellos la quieren mucho, que la Remedios no le llega a ninguna parte, que ella es la mas bonita de todas, en fin Gladis entiende que no ser feliz como mujer, que la vida parece que no le deparar un buen hombre, pero que como madre no hay quien le gane y al final como que es lo nico que vale la pena. En la casa de pascuita se termino la fiesta todos se despiden de ella y le agradecen la fiesta que parece que estuvo muy buena, menos para Felicita que no deja de comer por la tristeza que le causo el que Luis Fernando no la haya tomado en cuenta para nada. Alegr a como buena cuaima hace que Ernesto le confiese que la muchacha que a el le gusta no es otra que ella, lo que por supuesto le gusta o r, Pascuita le pide a su marido que abra el regalo como insiste tanto a ram n no le queda otro remedio, ve que es un malet n de trabajo. Gonzalo esta contento pues tambi n tiene lo que quer a su parrillera, claro que en realidad lo del matrimonio parece que no era la mejor idea y se conforma, le pide a su mujer que abra el regalo y cuando se da cuenta que es un malet n de trabajo se burla de ella como siempre, Matilde entiende cada vez mas que Ram n no hubiera hecho algo as . Al d a siguiente se presenta Pascuita bien temprano, Matilde se sorprende pues ya esta arreglada como de peluquer a, le lleva la comida que sobro de la noche anterior, la quiso fregar pero cuando vio que el malet n es igual al de su marido hasta all le llego la felicidad, se dijeron brujas las dos, claro pero con el pensamiento. R mulo esta molesto pues la familia de Betzaida amaneci y el ten a tiempo que no hac a algo as , decide pasar delante de la casa de Eglee, aprovecha que Betzaida se quedo dormida, pero cuando pasa ve que Santiago sale de la casa como a hurtadillas y el se pone furioso, tanto que despert a Betzaida quien le reclama que hace el all , que ya esa no es su casa y que se vayan para la suya de inmediato. Gladis llega temprano a la casa de Eglee, lleva a Gerson quien parece que trabajar como vigilante en el edificio de enfrente, pero Gladis nota que su patrona esta muy feliz, como que de verdad paso una noche buena, y a Eglee no le queda mas remedio que confesarle a Gladis que si que tuvo algo con un hombre que no es R mulo, Gladis se alegra por su patrona y le dice que si es mas joven que ella pues mejor, si lo dir ella que sabe tanto de eso. Alegr a esta muy preocupada por su hermana, que no para de vomitar, se lo dice a su mam pero esta ni la escucha, lo nico que le importa en estos momentos es quedar embarazada, le dice que le prepare una manzanilla y ya, Alegr a sabe que eso es otra cosa, que puede ser bulimia y que su hermana se las vera mal si sigue en ese estado. Dileidi se quiere cobrar el beso que Luis Fernando le dio a la miss, besa a Aureliano para que Luis Fernando vea, claro que el muchacho se pone bravo, pero quien aprovecha es Aureliano que se da cuenta de lo que pretende Dileidi y le da un beso pero de verdad, Dileidi le dice que se paso. R mulo esta decidido, si llega averiguar que Eglee tiene algo con Santiago lo matar .

programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, Mar a Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandon a las dos mucho tiempo atr s para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 90: Sospechas, Celos y Secretos Revelados
programme.desc: La Nena esta nerviosa y furiosa a la vez, pues no quiere que Aristigueta se entere que ella tiene pareja y menos de la clase de Doroteo, o sea un limpio, el trata por todos los medios de quedarse un rato mas y ella no haya que mas hacer para que se vaya, le dice que quiere hablar con su hija, despu s le pide el ba o prestado, ella le dice que no sirve, le dice que entonces le preste el de su cuarto, le dice que no sirve tampoco, luego hace una llamada y es justo al celular de Theo, cuando suena el tel fono Aristigueta ya no le cabe la menor duda y en efecto lo que el sospecha es cierto, ella esta empatada con la Nena, Theo responde la llamada y conversa de los mas amigable con su doctor, sin sospechar nada, luego Aristigueta complacido pues una vez mas se salio con la suya se retira, dejando a la Nena mas confundida que antes, por que ese hombre se le viene a aparecer en su vida ahora despu s de tantos a os, Theo se da cuenta que llora y le pregunta que le pasa ella le inventa un cuento. Otra que no le cabe la frustraci n y la rabia es a Gladis que al ver llegar a Remedios se le caen todas las esperanzas de tener algo con su Gabito, a el le pasa exactamente lo mismo, trata de arreglar la cosa, le dice a Gladis que se llevar a Remedios pero que el regresa para seguir con lo que estaban hablando, pero que va ya Gladis esta muy molesta y decide irse a dormir, a lo que Gabito lo toma cono un rechazo, ahora tendr que ver que se inventa para que a Gladis se le pase la rabia, Aureliano bromea con la llega de su mam , a Dileidi por supuesto que le molesta pues siempre le esta echando broma a su mam , cuando llega al cuarto encuentra a Gladis llorando y quej ndose de su mala suerte, ella trata de reanimarla, le dice que gracias a ella y a sus rega os descubri que le gusta realmente la ingenier a y que no solamente se va a graduar como ingeniero para complacerla a ella sino que lo har por doble raz n pues quiere ser una de las mejores, ya que le gusta lo que esta estudiando, tambi n suben al cuarto Gerson y Aleisi, quienes saben que su mam esta triste y le dicen que ellos la quieren mucho, que la Remedios no le llega a ninguna parte, que ella es la mas bonita de todas, en fin Gladis entiende que no ser feliz como mujer, que la vida parece que no le deparar un buen hombre, pero que como madre no hay quien le gane y al final como que es lo nico que vale la pena. En la casa de pascuita se termino la fiesta todos se despiden de ella y le agradecen la fiesta que parece que estuvo muy buena, menos para Felicita que no deja de comer por la tristeza que le causo el que Luis Fernando no la haya tomado en cuenta para nada. Alegr a como buena cuaima hace que Ernesto le confiese que la muchacha que a el le gusta no es otra que ella, lo que por supuesto le gusta o r, Pascuita le pide a su marido que abra el regalo como insiste tanto a ram n no le queda otro remedio, ve que es un malet n de trabajo. Gonzalo esta contento pues tambi n tiene lo que quer a su parrillera, claro que en realidad lo del matrimonio parece que no era la mejor idea y se conforma, le pide a su mujer que abra el regalo y cuando se da cuenta que es un malet n de trabajo se burla de ella como siempre, Matilde entiende cada vez mas que Ram n no hubiera hecho algo as . Al d a siguiente se presenta Pascuita bien temprano, Matilde se sorprende pues ya esta arreglada como de peluquer a, le lleva la comida que sobro de la noche anterior, la quiso fregar pero cuando vio que el malet n es igual al de su marido hasta all le llego la felicidad, se dijeron brujas las dos, claro pero con el pensamiento. R mulo esta molesto pues la familia de Betzaida amaneci y el ten a tiempo que no hac a algo as , decide pasar delante de la casa de Eglee, aprovecha que Betzaida se quedo dormida, pero cuando pasa ve que Santiago sale de la casa como a hurtadillas y el se pone furioso, tanto que despert a Betzaida quien le reclama que hace el all , que ya esa no es su casa y que se vayan para la suya de inmediato. Gladis llega temprano a la casa de Eglee, lleva a Gerson quien parece que trabajar como vigilante en el edificio de enfrente, pero Gladis nota que su patrona esta muy feliz, como que de verdad paso una noche buena, y a Eglee no le queda mas remedio que confesarle a Gladis que si que tuvo algo con un hombre que no es R mulo, Gladis se alegra por su patrona y le dice que si es mas joven que ella pues mejor, si lo dir ella que sabe tanto de eso. Alegr a esta muy preocupada por su hermana, que no para de vomitar, se lo dice a su mam pero esta ni la escucha, lo nico que le importa en estos momentos es quedar embarazada, le dice que le prepare una manzanilla y ya, Alegr a sabe que eso es otra cosa, que puede ser bulimia y que su hermana se las vera mal si sigue en ese estado. Dileidi se quiere cobrar el beso que Luis Fernando le dio a la miss, besa a Aureliano para que Luis Fernando vea, claro que el muchacho se pone bravo, pero quien aprovecha es Aureliano que se da cuenta de lo que pretende Dileidi y le da un beso pero de verdad, Dileidi le dice que se paso. R mulo esta decidido, si llega averiguar que Eglee tiene algo con Santiago lo matar .

programme.desc: Para satisfacer el deseo de su padre, un apuesto y poderoso multimillonario viaja solo, sin dinero y sin usar su nombre real a la ciudad de Nueva York. Cuando el ex playboy conoce a un agente inmobiliario atractivo y con los pies en la tierra, la razón detrás del deseo de su padre se vuelve evidente y ambos descubrirán que el amor verdadero es algo que el dinero no puede comprar.

programme.title: Cosmética Terror
programme.desc: Catalina es una maquillista de 35 años que trabaja en una funeraria y sueña con ser actriz. Una hada madrina aparece y le da la oportunidad de vivir su sueño: ser parte de su telenovela favorita: "Cosmética Horror".

programme.title: La Cacería: Las Niñas de Alto Hospicio
programme.sub-title: La Caceria: Las Ninas de Alto Hospicio - 72 Hours
programme.desc: El capitán Rojas llega al norte de Chile desde Santiago para investigar la misteriosa desaparición de un grupo de adolescentes en Alto Hospicio. Carrasco, un oficial de policía local asignado como su compañero, intenta explicarle la teoría oficial: las jóvenes huyeron de sus vidas infernales para prostituirse en el extranjero. La investigación de Rojas, combinada con la desaparición de la hija de un pescador local, revela una verdad más perturbadora. Rojas está convencido de que las chicas fueron secuestradas o asesinadas.

programme.title: La Cacería: Las Niñas de Alto Hospicio
programme.sub-title: La Caceria: Las Ninas de Alto Hospicio - Tacna
programme.desc: Información de inteligencia confirmada por el jefe de la policía de Alto Hospicio obliga a Rojas y Carrasco a viajar a Tacna, una ciudad peruana salvaje en la frontera con Chile. En Perú, Rojas se infiltra en las bandas de trata de personas que comercian con “esclavas blancas” en un intento por encontrar a las chicas chilenas desaparecidas, sin éxito. Después de que Carrasco lo rescata de una muerte segura en un club en Perú, regresa a Chile con una nueva teoría: hay un asesino en serie en Alto Hospicio.

programme.title: La Cacería: Las Niñas de Alto Hospicio
programme.sub-title: La Caceria: Las Ninas de Alto Hospicio - La Primera Victima
programme.desc: Tras revisar todos los asesinatos de mujeres en la zona, el capitán Rojas cree haber encontrado el "caso cero" de su asesino en serie: una prostituta cuyo cuerpo apareció en una playa hace dos años. Mientras Rojas sigue esta pista, Carrasco sospecha de un profesor de voleibol que enseñó a varias de las chicas desaparecidas. La información se difunde entre los vecinos, que quieren hacer justicia por su cuenta.

programme.title: La Cacería: Las Niñas de Alto Hospicio
programme.sub-title: La Caceria: Las Ninas de Alto Hospicio - Los Perros
programme.desc: Rojas sale del hospital tras recibir una brutal paliza en la que Carrasco también participó en secreto. El intento de intimidarlo solo refuerza su necesidad de seguir investigando, pero su teoría se desmorona cuando se prueba la inocencia del conductor de La Ponderosa, a quien consideraba el principal sospechoso. Paralelamente, Andrea investiga el pasado de Rojas y una amenaza contra su hijo Diego lleva al capitán al límite.

programme.title: La Cacería: Las Niñas de Alto Hospicio
programme.sub-title: La Caceria: Las Ninas de Alto Hospicio - Todas las Familias
programme.desc: Después de exponer la corrupción y amenazar a su superior, Rojas continúa su investigación sin el apoyo de la policía. Una nueva pista lo lleva a investigar un secreto dentro de la familia Ávila. Andrea gana la confianza de la hermana de Valeria Ávila, cuyo testimonio los acerca a la verdadera identidad del asesino. Ayleen intenta reencauzar su vida, sin saber el peligro que eso conlleva, ya que el psicópata de Alto Hospicio busca una nueva víctima.

programme.title: La Cacería: Las Niñas de Alto Hospicio
programme.sub-title: La Caceria: Las Ninas de Alto Hospicio - El Pozo
programme.desc: Rojas está convencido de haber descubierto la identidad del psicópata, pero no tiene pruebas. Viaja al pueblo natal del asesino, donde descubre el origen de sus instintos violentos. Ayleen sobrevive a un brutal ataque y su testimonio se convierte en la clave para encontrar al psicópata. Rojas y Carrasco deben unir fuerzas nuevamente para quebrar al asesino y obtener la confesión que necesitan. Finalmente, Rojas se enfrenta cara a cara con el psicópata de Alto Hospicio.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.desc: A maximum-security prison goes into serious lockdown mode when a shape-shifting demon with an insatiable taste for human flesh unleashes its fury on the inmates and guards.

programme.title: Sennentuntschi
programme.desc: 1975, Swiss Alps: In a remote mountain village, a beautiful and mysterious woman shows up. Only the village policeman takes care of the strange woman and tries to find out who she is. There are hints that she came from the H??henalp Alp, where herdsmen do unthinkable things to get the company of women. Many dark truths are revealed that should better have remained hidden. A tragedy of lust, insanity and murder is brought to a seemlingly pure and perfect world. It is the beginning of a nightmare of religious insanity, hypocrisy, abuse and belief in demons, who destroys a young family and brings a whole village to destruction.

programme.title: Psychos in Love
programme.desc: A strip-joint owner and a manicurist find that they have many things in common, the foremost being that they are psychotic serial killers. They fall in love and are happy being the family that slays together, until one day they come up against a plumber who also happens to be a cannibal.

programme.title: The Coed and the Zombie Stoner
programme.desc: When a sorority girl falls in love with a zombie, it's only a matter of time before a zombie apocalypse is unleashed on campus. The sorority girl discovers that weed is the cure. Now, she must smoke out the whole school before it's too late.

programme.title: Dracula in Love
programme.desc: Leila, a lonely young soul spends the night partying with her friends Nancy, David and Nash in a warehouse. As the boys drink up and smoke pot all social barriers between the sexes crumble. Leila, hit on by both men, hides away from them. Alone she senses there is someone else who wants her and certainly he is not of this world. A 200 year old Dracula escapes from a crate and reveals himself to Leila and tells her that she is his lost love. For him to live again and be with her, she must bring him the blood of her friends to drink and make love to him. Hypnotized by his sexual powers, Leila does as she is told. Leila and a handsome young Dracula get away and live happily ever after.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: En este espisodio nos visitó Liz Guarneros, experta en empleabilidad y desarrollo profesional, sobre las claves para destacar en el mundo laboral actual. Desde consejos para construir un currículum efectivo hasta estrategias para causar una buena impresión en entrevistas, Liz comparte herramientas prácticas que ayudan a mejorar la presencia profesional en un mercado altamente competitivo. La charla aborda temas fundamentales como la importancia de tener una red laboral sólida, la relevancia de las habilidades blandas, el impacto del lenguaje corporal y cómo la inteligencia artificial ya forma parte del proceso de reclutamiento. Además, Liz desmitifica aspectos comunes como el uso de la foto en el CV, el rol de las palabras clave para superar filtros automatizados, y cómo adaptar el discurso al perfil de cada empresa. Con un estilo claro y directo, Liz ofrece tips precisos que van desde el diseño del currículum hasta cómo prepararse mentalmente para una entrevista. Este episodio es una guía esencial para quienes buscan empleo o quieren crecer profesionalmente en un entorno donde conectar, comunicar y presentarse bien marcan la diferencia.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: Conversamos con Fernanda de la Colina, especialista en educación financiera y cofundadora de Zumma, sobre los pilares fundamentales para tener unas finanzas personales sanas, realistas y sostenibles. Con un enfoque accesible y práctico, Fernanda explica conceptos clave como el interés compuesto, el manejo del crédito, las deudas buenas y malas, y la importancia de invertir desde edades tempranas. A través de respuestas rápidas, cápsulas informativas y consejos claros, este episodio busca desmitificar el mundo financiero y empoderar a las personas para tomar mejores decisiones con su dinero. - Este episodio es una guía útil para quienes quieren comenzar a organizar sus finanzas, ahorrar con propósito o entender cómo y por qué invertir, todo desde una mirada fresca, joven y fundamentada.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion - La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion
programme.desc: Conversamos con Jerónimo Best, actor y productor de teatro que ha llevado su carrera a escenarios nacionales e internacionales, incluyendo la Royal Shakespeare Company en Reino Unido. Jerónimo nos comparte sus inicios en el teatro, la emoción de pisar escenarios legendarios y cómo la actuación, en inglés y en español, transforma la manera de sentir y comunicar emociones. Además, Jerónimo reflexiona sobre su labor como productor, traductor y adaptador de proyectos teatrales, así como la importancia de crear equipos actorales que funcionen como una familia. Con humor, sensibilidad y mucha pasión por el oficio, Jerónimo nos invita a mirar el teatro como un espacio donde la ficción detiene el tiempo y nos recuerda el poder de las historias para emocionar, unir y transformar.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion - La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion
programme.desc: La actriz, productora y activista social Vanessa Bauche nos acompaña para compartir su inspiradora trayectoria artística y personal. Vanessa rememora su autodeterminación desde temprana edad y sus primeros acercamientos al arte y la actuación. A lo largo del programa, reflexiona sobre los prejuicios en la industria, la importancia del teatro, y su activismo social. Desde su icónica participación en “Amores Perros” hasta su reconocimiento internacional, Vanessa habla de su vocación, sus desafíos y aprendizajes. Así como la importancia de la salud mental, la autoaceptación y su filosofía de vida: “La mujer que se tiene a sí misma nunca está sola”. Un recorrido íntimo por la carrera y visión de una de las actrices más reconocidas de México, galardonada con múltiples premios Ariel y aclamada tanto en cine como en teatro.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion - La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion
programme.desc: Conversamos con Sergio Gutiérrez, actor, guionista y director independiente, sobre sus inicios en la actuación, su pasión por los escenarios y el proceso de construir personajes completos. Con una trayectoria que incluye participaciones en series de televisión, streaming y teatro, Sergio comparte anécdotas de sets masivos, entrenamientos con dobles de riesgo y su paso por producciones como míticas. Reflexionamos sobre la importancia de no juzgar a sus propios personajes, la presencia total en escena, y el valor del capital humano en tiempos de inteligencia artificial. Una charla auténtica y dinámica que revela lo que significa vivir la actuación desde todas sus trincheras.

programme.title: Curandero
programme.desc: Un drama psicológico sobre un talentoso neurocirujano que salva vidas. Como resultado de los celos de su mejor amigo, el protagonista se encuentra en una situación trágica que cambia radicalmente la vida. El neurocirujano Pavel Andreev regresa a un hospital en San Petersburgo tras años en el extranjero. Su mentor, Semenov, le revela que tiene un tumor avanzado. Pavel conoce a su hija, Marina, y promete operarlo.

programme.title: Curandero
programme.desc: Semenov pone a Pavel en las operaciones más complejas, lo que genera tensiones con sus colegas. Pavel y Marina inician un romance y él le propone matrimonio. En una cirugía televisada, Pavel brilla, pero es secuestrado.

programme.title: Curandero
programme.desc: Pavel es golpeado y enviado en un tren a un destino desconocido. Marina y Sergey intentan encontrarlo. Pavel, dado por muerto, despierta en un bosque y llega a una aldea sin recuerdos de su pasado.

programme.title: Curandero
programme.desc: Mientras Marina sigue su búsqueda, Semenov se deteriora y Sergey decide operarlo. Un anciano y una médica rural cuidan de Pavel, quien no recuerda quién es.

programme.title: Curandero
programme.desc: Pavel muestra un talento innato para la medicina en la aldea. Marina contrata un detective para encontrarlo. Semenov descubre que su operación fue fallida.

programme.title: Curandero
programme.desc: Se revelan secretos del pasado de Alexei, el hombre con quien confunden a Pavel. Marina encuentra pistas sobre los secuestradores de Pavel. Sergey sigue involucrado con criminales.

programme.title: Curandero
programme.desc: Marina se acerca a los responsables del secuestro de Pavel. En la aldea, Pavel recibe un pasaporte con el nombre de Alexei, pero tiene dudas sobre su identidad.

programme.title: Curandero
programme.desc: Pavel realiza un rescate en una grave emergencia, lo que le provoca intensos dolores de cabeza. Marina no detiene su búsqueda. Sergey sigue atrapado en la mafia médica.
